name: AgenStudio
tagline: An independent bilingual digital studio presence from Cameroon, pairing deliberately lightweight web engineering with selected project case studies.
problem: A studio portfolio cannot build trust through animations or vague claims alone. Clients need clear project work, services, multilingual navigation and an accessible contact path that does not expose server-side credentials.
scenario: A prospective client reviews bilingual case studies, finds appropriate studio services and submits a validated inquiry through a protected backend endpoint rather than exposing the studio mailbox or email provider tokens.
differentiation: Astro static-first pages keep presentation lean, while typed project collections, localized SEO and a Cloudflare Pages Function protect the dynamic contact flow.
architecture: Astro 7 bilingual pages + typed case studies + targeted React islands -> Cloudflare Pages; contact form -> validation/Turnstile/KV -> Resend via server-side Pages Function.
limitations: A deployed website does not prove agency headcount, testimonials, conversion rates or individual projects' private commercial outcomes. Contact delivery requires configured backend secrets and service bindings; project case studies must remain factual.

capabilities.name: Localized studio site
capabilities.description: Publish FR/EN studio, services and project views with SEO metadata.

capabilities.name: Typed portfolio cases
capabilities.description: Maintain project entries through typed collection data rather than ad-hoc components.

capabilities.name: Protected contact form
capabilities.description: Implement validated contact handling with Turnstile and backend email dispatch.

roadmap.name: Editorial proof
roadmap.exitCriteria: Review published project cases and translations against real deliverables before portfolio updates.

roadmap.name: Production contact checks
roadmap.exitCriteria: Verify domain, Turnstile, KV and Resend configuration with authorized non-spam test cases.

references.relevance: Central read-only verification of documentation quality and managed presentation.
